text_block_list.text:
Ahhh... The air is always so nice and
peacesful at
shrines, don't you think?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски
choice_data_list: Is that why you wanted to come here?

text_block_list.text:
You know the saying "sickness starts in
the mind,"
right? I thought I'd try to
chase off some bad
feelings! ♪
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: We'll be done in a jiffy!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: Whew, I feel so refreshed! This is great!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Now I can party all night at the disco!
Hehe,
psych! ♪
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Let's get back to the academy at Mach
five! I've
got training to do!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: I'm going to burn up the track today!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Okay, that's it for the shrine! Let's get
back to the
academy right away!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Oh, no! Tata's keys are missing! I put
them in my
pocket, but they're not there
anymore...
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Heinous! Where did you go, my little
keys?!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
We came all the way to the shrine, but I
still have
bad luck. This is totally wack...
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Perhaps because of the unfortunate turn
of
events, Марузенски's condition does
not improve.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She really seems to get her groove back
after
praying at the shrine. Even her
driving is sharper
than usual.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
